record.question: It’s holiday. You _________ go to school today.
record.explanation: The holiday removes the necessity to attend school, so need not is the best offered completion. Must not would prohibit attendance rather than remove obligation. Evidence: https://dictionary.cambridge.org/grammar/british-grammar/need ; https://learnenglish.britishcouncil.org/free-resources/grammar/b1-b2/modals-permission-obligation Independently checked solution, unofficial.
